items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I worked one time too with a little outfit at the Roosevelt Hotel, and Harold Jaudy was the leader.

ctx.x: I think Julian Lane might have played trombone in it. Of course, the trombone I think changed a couple of times, but I think Julian played one time there too. I worked one time too with a little outfit at the Roosevelt Hotel, and Harold Jaudy was the leader. Harold Jaudy played sax there, clarinet. He played, Harold played real good sax and clarinet too.
